_meta.purpose: Published amendments per standard, so a tender cites the standard as amended rather than as originally published.
_meta.method: Read from BIS product manuals and published amendment documents. Recorded only where a source states the amendment exists; dates are recorded only where a source states the date.
_meta.coverage_warning: Only a few standards have been researched. A standard absent from this file has NOT been checked for amendments -- that is not a statement that it has none. Where a count is known but individual amendment dates are not, the count is recorded and the unknown dates are left null rather than invented.
_meta.why_this_matters: An amendment can change the material, the test regime or the acceptance criteria. A tender citing the base edition of a standard that has since been amended can specify something that is no longer conformant.

IS 694:2010.count_source: BIS Product Manual PM/IS 694/3, May 2020, 'No. of Amendments: 4'
